correct_linear_null_rationale: Under a reconstruction (variance-maximizing) objective the top-k subspace of a linear encoder is the block PCA subspace; a near-linear nonlinear encoder therefore degenerates to block PCA, so block PCA is the exact linear ceiling the test arm must beat. A supervised (phenotype-aware) null such as block-PLS is NOT used here and would be the wrong null for this objective.
seed_namespace_note: disjoint from v6.1 (629e6) and from any v7 GPU/A1-R seed block

A_test_primary.name: nonlinear_reconstruction_topk
A_test_primary.why_primary: fully closed-form given a frozen bandwidth; no SGD nondeterminism; needs no Transformer and no GPU; isolates whether nonlinear spectral compression has headroom over the linear reconstruction optimum

A_test_secondary.name: shallow_block_autoencoder_topk
A_test_secondary.note: trained per block on training folds only; CPU; still not a Transformer

B_rand_bilinear.name: random_bilinear_quadratic_features_dim_k
B_rand_bilinear.note: isolates whether the Grassmann geometry did anything beyond adding a same-dim quadratic feature

phenotype_simulator.why_simulated: the frozen panel is 1KGP genotypes with no rich real phenotypes; all phenotype-signal readouts are therefore on simulated traits with a KNOWN genetic architecture
phenotype_simulator.unifies: the metric-vs-k curve and the causal-retention curve are two readouts of the SAME simulated runs

causal_retention.definition: fraction of injected causal variance recoverable by the frozen downstream linear model from the k-dim representation, relative to the full-genotype ceiling

kill_criteria.primary_stage_1_2_kill: if A_test_primary does not beat B_pca at matched k across the trait panel in BOTH within-block and between-block regimes, by a margin whose CV-based uncertainty interval excludes zero, then Stage 1 (spectral compression) + Stage 2 (Grassmann mixing) have no reason to exist
kill_criteria.geometry_specificity_kill: if A_test_primary beats B_pca but does not beat B_rand_bilinear by the same standard, the win is a generic quadratic feature and the Grassmann-specific claim fails even if nonlinearity helps
kill_criteria.margin_and_uncertainty: pre-registered; margin threshold and CV-fold uncertainty rule frozen before any run
